literal_meaning: Chanting or repeating with a rosary beads
figurative_meaning_en: Reciting or chanting the name of God
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে প্রতিদিন সকালে মালা জপে ভক্তি প্রকাশ করে।
দুঃখের সময় মালা জপা মনকে শান্ত করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He expresses devotion by chanting the rosary every morning.
Chanting the rosary brings peace to the mind in times of sorrow.
history: This idiom draws from the ancient Hindu practice of japa, where a mala (string of beads) is used to count repetitions of mantras or divine names, a tradition also adopted in Bengali Muslim tasbih practices.
note: Common in both Hindu and Muslim Bengali communities for devotional purposes.
